about: vt's application mutants (DOD track DT1 and DT2); each is judged by the example's laws and cases (scripts/examples vt), not by a compiler test. The rule of each names the law or the case that kills it.

mutants.name: dt1-csi-param-colon
mutants.from:
case Digit, Colon, Semi:
			to(CsiParam, ParamByte)
mutants.to:
case Digit, Semi:
			to(CsiParam, ParamByte)
		case Colon:
			to(CsiIgnore, NoAct)
mutants.rule: In csi_param a colon is a parameter byte (Ghostty's change to vt100.net, which sends it to csi_ignore), for SGR sub-parameters. Killed by law ghostty.StepMatchesTable.

mutants.name: dt1-class-sub-not-cancel
mutants.rule: SUB (0x1a) cancels a sequence from any state, as CAN does. Killed by law ghostty.StepMatchesTable.

mutants.name: dt1-params-unbounded
mutants.from: Counts{Params: if k.Params < MaxParams { k.Params + 1 } else { k.Params }, Inter: k.Inter, Digits: false}
mutants.to: Counts{Params: k.Params + 1, Inter: k.Inter, Digits: false}
mutants.rule: A separator past MaxParams parameters completes none, so the collector's array is never overrun. Killed by law Parser.ParamsStayBounded.

mutants.name: dt1-params-limit-low
mutants.rule: The parser keeps Ghostty's 24 parameters (Kakoune sends 17 in one SGR). Killed by law Parser.ParamsReachTheLimit, and by the cases.

mutants.name: dt1-intermediates-limit-low
mutants.from: Inter: if k.Inter < MaxIntermediates { k.Inter + 1 } else { k.Inter }
mutants.to: Inter: if k.Inter < 3 { k.Inter + 1 } else { k.Inter }
mutants.rule: The parser keeps 4 intermediates, as Ghostty does. Killed by law Parser.IntermediatesReachTheLimit, and by case vt/events-sequences.

mutants.name: dt1-fast-text-takes-backspace
mutants.rule: The fast path takes only printable ASCII; a control after text goes through the machine. Killed by law vt.FastPathMatchesStep.

mutants.name: dt1-fast-osc-takes-bel
mutants.rule: The OSC fast path stops at a control, so BEL still ends the string. Killed by law vt.FastPathMatchesStep.

mutants.name: dt1-utf8-reset-per-piece
mutants.rule: A UTF-8 character cut between two pieces is decoded whole: the decoder's state carries across Feed. Killed by law vt.SplitDoesNotMatter.

mutants.name: dt1-osc-unbounded
mutants.rule: An OSC string keeps at most OscLimit bytes and counts the rest. Killed by case vt/events-tally (osc-cut 156).

mutants.name: dt1-param-not-clamped
mutants.from: p.acc = if v > MaxParam { MaxParam } else { v }
mutants.rule: A parameter saturates at 65535, as Ghostty's u16 does. Killed by case vt/events-sequences (CSI 99999 C).

mutants.name: dt1-utf8-surrogate-accepted
mutants.rule: UTF-8 has no surrogates: ED A0 80 is three bad bytes. Killed by case vt/events-sequences.

mutants.name: dt1-colon-outside-sgr
mutants.rule: Only SGR takes colon sub-parameters; another CSI with one is dropped, as in Ghostty. Killed by case vt/events-sequences (CSI 4:3 H).

mutants.name: dt2-style-never-freed
mutants.rule: release gives the set its Release, so a style whose count falls to 0 leaves it (the set's own rule is dense's ReleaseThenReuse). Killed by law screen.StylesAreCounted.

mutants.name: dt2-pen-not-counted
mutants.rule: The pen holds a count on its style, so the style stays while the pen holds it. Killed by law screen.StylesAreCounted.

mutants.name: dt2-styled-flag-missing
mutants.rule: A row with a styled cell is flagged, so clearing it releases its styles. Killed by law screen.StylesAreCounted.

mutants.name: dt2-clear-skips-release
mutants.rule: Clearing a styled row releases each cell's style (a dropped page too). Killed by law screen.StylesAreCounted.

mutants.name: dt2-history-limit-early
mutants.rule: The history keeps HistoryLimit lines and drops a page only past it. Killed by law screen.ScreenMatchesPlain.

mutants.name: dt2-ring-spare-pages
mutants.rule: The ring holds the history's pages, the buffer's and one, no more. Killed by law screen.ScrollbackIsBounded.

mutants.name: dt2-grow-every-push
mutants.rule: Once the ring is full, a line feed makes no cell: the oldest page is used again (Ghostty's leak, as a counted growth guard). Killed by law screen.ScrollbackIsBounded.

mutants.name: dt2-print-pending-always
mutants.rule: With autowrap off, printing at the last column leaves no wrap pending. Killed by law screen.ScreenMatchesPlain.

mutants.name: dt2-split-misses-head
mutants.rule: Overwriting the head of a wide character blanks its tail. Killed by law screen.ScreenMatchesPlain.

mutants.name: dt2-shift-down-skips-top
mutants.rule: A scroll down moves every row of the region, the top one too. Killed by law screen.ScreenMatchesPlain.

mutants.name: dt2-free-id-stale-style
mutants.rule: A cell shows the style its id names (a reused id's new style is dense's ReleaseThenReuse). Killed by law screen.ScreenMatchesPlain.

mutants.name: dt2-reset-keeps-pen
mutants.rule: RIS resets the pen. Killed by law screen.ScreenMatchesPlain.

mutants.name: dt2-ich-keeps-orphans
mutants.rule: An insert that cuts a wide character blanks its other half. Killed by law screen.ScreenMatchesPlain.

mutants.name: dt2-cell-part-overlaps
mutants.rule: The part's bits lie above the 21 bits of the code point. Killed by law screen.CellFieldsRoundTrip.

mutants.name: dt2-width-first-wide
mutants.rule: U+1100, the first Hangul Jamo, is wide. Killed by law width.WidthTableMatchesRanges.

mutants.name: dt2-sgr-bright-off-by-one
mutants.rule: SGR 90 to 97 are palette colours 8 to 15. Killed by case vt/replay-gen.

mutants.name: dt2-form-feed-not-line-feed
mutants.rule: FF is a line feed, as LF and VT are. Killed by case vt/replay-gen.

mutants.name: dt2-history-two-pages
mutants.rule: A history too small for a page keeps one page. Both providers read HistoryPages, so they still agree; killed by law vt.Screen.HistoryDropsOldestPage, for screen.Screen and plain.Screen, borrow providers.

mutants.name: dt2-dch-keeps-orphans
mutants.rule: A delete that cuts a wide character blanks its other half. Killed by law screen.ScreenMatchesPlain.

mutants.name: dt2-erase-no-split
mutants.to:
let at = ri * s.cols
	for col in from..to {
mutants.rule: An erase that cuts a wide character blanks its other half. Killed by law screen.ScreenMatchesPlain.
